//: ECHO config. Copy to ~/.echo/config.json and edit. Reloaded on launch.
//preset2: values below; anything you set explicitly overrides the preset.

sound.//muteWhenFullscreen: Producer's rule #1: never make noise over a game,
sound.//muteWhenFullscreen2: video, or a shared screen. Goes fully silent then.

voice.//onlyBigMoments: true = he only SPEAKS on Jackpot / Devil Trigger / leaving.
voice.//onlyBigMoments2: Small stuff stays silent. The calmest setting.

chatter.//ambientChance: How often a work/idle line even appears (0-1). Low = texture.

scenes.//: The big animated moments. Rarer = more special.

presence.//awayAfterMin: No AI activity this long -> he takes a break and walks off.

life.//idleHoldScale: Multiplier on how long he rests between idle poses. >1 = calmer.
life.//quietHours: [startHour, endHour] local — silent + sleepy in this window.

position.//footSink: How deep his feet rest into the taskbar. 0 = on the edge.
